title: Safer cancellations and clearer errors
notes: Improved: Canceling a Windows delete now stops the move to the Recycle Bin when possible and explains when Windows is still finishing.
Improved: Plugin errors now show the most useful error detail and save a log that can be opened even when the console is unavailable.
Fixed: Progress dialogs can show operation-specific cancellation messages, and quicksearch remains reliable with fractional widths.
